experimental_design.evidence: inferred: Fasting blood samples were collected at different time-points (Fig. 1).

inferred: Control subjects and type 2 diabetic patients were given deuterium-labeled (heavy) water for a seven-day period and their plasma serum proteins were analyzed by high-resolution mass spectrometry.

factor_value.evidence: inferred: Nine newly diagnosed diet-controlled T2DM patients (4:5, male/female) and eight age- and body mass index (BMI)-matched non-diabetic control (4:4, male/female) subjects were enrolled to this study.

technology_type.evidence: A volume approximately equivalent to 0.1 µg protein was injected into a Q Exactive Plus hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) using an UltiMate 3000 RSLC nano-HPLC system (Dionex, Sunnyvale, CA).
